decisions: passed: The initial fresh login and interactive shell resolved the real legacy global-npm command; after installation both resolved the new user-space jarn 1.0.3 command.
passed: The installer returned activation status 10, retained the legacy executable byte-for-byte, and displayed explicit optional-cleanup and never-delete guidance.

passed: The first doctor invocation reported the migration transition; a second invocation reported global_status=current, schema 3, the preserved custom route, network.checked=false, and controlled status 1 for the intentionally unresolved credential.
limitations: This final-candidate UAT transferred the exact v1.0.3 installer source and reproducible wheel into an isolated remote /tmp fixture; the wheel SHA-256 is byte-identical to the immutable tag workflow artifact for commit 5b002730566918958d9dbb3c8014d83f4ceeda90, while the public-URL canary remains a separate release gate.

result: On Ubuntu 22.04/glibc 2.35, the exact final v1.0.3 wheel (SHA-256 68a340ce6af9acadadd1621905f8849a965fa3f8caab0e82ead8077ccc2601d4) replaced PATH precedence over the retained real global-npm command, preserved that command, and migrated a customized schema-0 config to schema 3 with one byte-identical backup and valid diagnostics.
